result.summary: 这篇论文研究如何用最简单的方法实现测试时扩展（test-time scaling）并获得强推理性能 [S1.p1]。作者构建了仅含 1,000 个样本的 s1K 数据集，对 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 做监督微调，并提出 budget forcing 在测试时控制思考 token 数量 [S1.p2]。s1-32B 在竞赛数学题上超过 o1-preview 最多 27%，并可将 AIME24 从 50% 提升到 57% [abstract]。作者还通过消融实验说明数据选择中难度、多样性、质量三者结合的重要性，以及 budget forcing 在可控性和扩展斜率上的优势 [S1.p3]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：在 OpenAI o1 未公开方法、众多复现尝试均未公开复现出清晰测试时扩展行为的情况下，实现测试时扩展和强推理性能的最简单方法是什么 [S1.p1]。其动机在于测试时扩展这一新范式已被 o1 验证有效，但已有复现依赖大规模强化学习或大量数据 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Thus, we ask: what is the simplest approach to achieve both test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance?
the viability of this paradigm was recently validated by OpenAI o1
none have openly replicated a clear test-time scaling behavior

method.text: 论文提出两个简单方法：一是构建 s1K 数据集，即 1,000 个经过难度、多样性、质量三原则筛选的问题及推理轨迹，并对现成预训练模型做监督微调 [S1.p2][S2.SS2.p1]。二是 budget forcing，一种解码时干预：超过上限时追加思考结束符提前结束思考，想增加计算时抑制结束符并追加“Wait”以鼓励更多探索 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者将测试时扩展方法分为顺序式与并行式，并聚焦顺序式扩展 [S3.SS1.p1]。

evidence.quote: We show that training on only 1,000 samples with next-token prediction and controlling thinking duration via a simple test-time technique we refer to as budget forcing leads to a strong reasoning model
we go through three stages of filtering to arrive at a minimal set of 1,000 samples relying on our three guiding data principles: Quality, Difficulty, and Diversity.
We propose a simple decoding-time intervention by forcing a maximum and/or minimum number of thinking tokens.
we suppress the generation of the end-of-thinking token delimiter and optionally append the string “Wait” to the model’s current reasoning trace
We classify test-time scaling methods into 1) Sequential, where later computations depend on earlier ones

experiments.text: 论文在三个推理基准上评估：AIME24（30 题）、MATH500（500 题）和 GPQA Diamond（198 题），默认温度 0、贪心解码、测准确率 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。对比模型包括 OpenAI o1 系列、DeepSeek r1 系列、QwQ-32B-preview、Sky-T1-32B-Preview、Bespoke-32B 和 Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking Experimental [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1]。作者还做了数据选择消融和测试时扩展方法消融，并用 Control、Scaling、Performance 三个指标衡量扩展方法 [S1.p3][S3.SS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: We select three representative reasoning benchmarks widely used in the field: AIME24 has 30 problems
MATH500 is a benchmark of competition math problems of varying difficulty.
GPQA Diamond consists of 198 PhD-level science questions from Biology, Chemistry and Physics.
we evaluate with a temperature of 0 (greedy) and measure accuracy (equivalent to pass@1).
We benchmark s1-32B against: OpenAI o1 series, closed-source models that popularized test-time scaling; DeepSeek r1 series
We conduct extensive ablation experiments targeting (a) our selection of 1,000 (1K) reasoning samples and (b) our test-time scaling.
We measure three metrics: Control, Scaling, and Performance

findings.text: s1-32B 在竞赛数学题上超过 o1-preview 最多 27%（MATH 和 AIME24）[abstract]。用 budget forcing 扩展 s1-32B 可将其在 AIME24 上的表现从 50% 外推到 57% [abstract]。数据选择方面，随机选择、选最长推理轨迹或只选最大多样性都会导致明显更差的表现（AIME24 平均约 -30%），而在 59K 全量数据池上训练相比 1K 选择没有显著增益 [S1.p3]。测试时扩展方面，budget forcing 具有完美可控性和清晰正斜率，扩展效果最好 [S1.p3]；在基础模型上用多数投票做并行扩展无法追上 s1-32B [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。s1-32B 是最样本高效的开放数据推理模型，显著优于其基础模型 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

evidence.quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
from 50% to 57% on AIME24
Random selection, selecting samples with the longest reasoning traces, or only selecting maximally diverse samples all lead to significantly worse performance (around $-$ 30% on AIME24 on average).
Training on our full data pool of 59K examples, a superset of s1K, does not offer substantial gains over our 1K selection.
Budget forcing leads to the best scaling as it has perfect controllability with a clear positive slope leading to strong performance.
Scaling test-time compute on the base model via majority voting cannot catch up with the performance of s1-32B
We find that s1-32B is the most sample-efficient open data reasoning model.
It performs significantly better than our base model (Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct) despite just training it on an additional 1,000 samples.

limitations.text: 作者指出 budget forcing 在进一步扩展时有两个关键限制：最终会趋于平坦，且受底层语言模型上下文窗口约束 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。此外，抑制思考结束符过于频繁可能使模型陷入重复循环而非继续推理 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者还提到，能否仅用 1,000 个样本达到 r1-32B 的性能仍是一个开放问题 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

evidence.quote: it has two key limitations when scaling further: it eventually flattens out ( Figure 4), and the context window of the underlying language model constrains it.
Suppressing the end-of-thinking token delimiter too often can lead the model into repetitive loops instead of continued reasoning.
It is an open question whether one can achieve their performance with just 1,000 samples.
